blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Mark Villar hopes that the Philippines’ hosting of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit will lead to more investments, job opportunities, and other economic benefits for Filipinos and other people across the region. “We are hoping that the Philippine leadership in Asean will yield more opportunities for our countrymen. It is important that we use this opportunity to attract new investments, create jobs, and strengthen our local industries,” Villar said in a statement on Sunday. “At the same time, we also need to address the problems that our people continue to experience, especially the […]...
